description: This file defines the class OA_Admin_UI_Rule_JQueryRuleAdaptorRegistry, which manages registration and retrieval of jQuery rule adaptors for quickform validation within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Rule_JQueryRuleAdaptorRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class that manages registration and retrieval of jQuery rule adaptors for quickform validation.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the registry.

methods.name: registerJQueryRuleAdaptor
methods.description: Registers a jQuery rule adaptor for a given quickform rule.

methods.name: getJQueryRuleAdaptor
methods.description: Retrieves an adaptor instance capable of providing jQuery validation for a specific quickform rule.
